chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: Planning the fiftieth anniversary guests: Basie band and Louie Bellson
summary: Basie's band will play, Sonny Cohn is arranging it, and he hopes Louie Bellson will come.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: So he's going to be at your 50th anniversary.
Yeah, he's going to be at the 50th anniversary, and no problem of getting him at all. He was only too happy. I talked with Sonny, the musical director. He takes care of most all of the business.
Yeah. So they're going to play with Billy Eckstein sometime this month or the first of next month, anyway, for four days. So he told me, don't have to worry about a rehearsal. That's $400.
See, so you don't have to worry with
the rehearsal. We'll save you that amount of money. So it's like that type of a feeling.
Do you expect anyone else to come on?
Well, I'm looking for Louis because he's going to be in town.
